positive_cases.name: main_sudoers_written
positive_cases.scenario: Main privilege configuration file written by an editor.
positive_cases.rationale: Path selection matches and the package manager filter does not apply.

positive_cases.name: include_fragment_written
positive_cases.scenario: Privilege fragment written into the include directory.
positive_cases.rationale: Path selection matches and the package manager filter does not apply.

negative_cases.name: unrelated_configuration_file
negative_cases.rationale: The path selection does not match.

negative_cases.name: package_manager_fragment
negative_cases.scenario: Package manager installs its own privilege fragment.
negative_cases.rationale: Path matches but the package manager filter removes the event.

negative_cases.name: backup_copy_outside_directory
negative_cases.scenario: Backup copy of the configuration written elsewhere.
negative_cases.rationale: The startswith path selection does not match a backup directory.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
